$comment: The request body limit of the local API (POST /api/v1/inspect/tool among its routes) and what the OpenClaw plugin keeps in reserve. One source: the gateway reads body_max_bytes from this embedded file (internal/gateway apiRequestBodyMaxBytes) and the plugin build copies the file next to its sources (make plugin) and sends a call whole up to body_max_bytes - plugin_envelope_margin_bytes (rel-1-0-10:GAP-0402, GAP-0436).
